source.test: ensureActiveWorldSlotExists(for:) — no active slot, no existing slots at all

expected.new_slot_last_played_at: set to now at creation time

notes: This is the bootstrap path a server that predates the persistent-slot model takes the first time a slot-dependent operation runs against it: WorldSlotManager.activeSlot returns nil (line 64), loadSlots is empty so the existing.max(by:) fallback also returns nil (lines 73-74), so control falls through to WorldSlotManager.createSlot (lines 83-89) zipping the current live world folders into a brand-new slot. Unlike an ordinary createSlot call, the caller here immediately sets created.lastPlayedAt = Date() (line 93) before persisting -- this bootstrap slot is being marked as already-active/already-played on creation, not left at nil like a freshly-saved snapshot slot (contrast slot-metadata-json-defaults.json and fresh-archive-less-slot-creation.json, where lastPlayedAt starts nil). Both saveMetadata and setActiveSlotID run afterward (lines 95-96) so the new slot is both persisted and marked as the active slot in one pass. defaultPersistentSlotName (lines 51-61) capitalizes the first letter of a non-empty Java level-name -- "world" becomes "World" -- which is why new_slot_name differs in case from world_level_name.
